insert into [rpy].[Exchange_Rates_Data]
(ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE10,ATTRIBUTE11,ATTRIBUTE12,ATTRIBUTE13,ATTRIBUTE14,ATTRIBUTE15,ATTRIBUTE2,ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY,ATTRIBUTE_DATE1,ATTRIBUTE_DATE2,ATTRIBUTE_DATE3,ATTRIBUTE_DATE4,ATTRIBUTE_DATE5,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4,ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5,CONVERSION_DATE
,CONVERSION_RATE,CONVERSION_TYPE,CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,ENTERPRISE_ID,FROM_CURRENCY,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,RATE_SOURCE_CODE,STATUS_CODE
,TO_CURRENCY,source_name,sub_source_name,created_date_time)
select
a.ATTRIBUTE1,a.ATTRIBUTE10,a.ATTRIBUTE11,a.ATTRIBUTE12,a.ATTRIBUTE13,a.ATTRIBUTE14,a.ATTRIBUTE15,a.ATTRIBUTE2,a.ATTRIBUTE3,a.ATTRIBUTE4,a.ATTRIBUTE5,a.ATTRIBUTE6,a.ATTRIBUTE7,a.ATTRIBUTE8,a.ATTRIBUTE9,a.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE1,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE2,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE3,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE4,a.ATTRIBUTE_DATE5,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER1,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER2,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER3,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER4,a.ATTRIBUTE_NUMBER5,a.CONVERSION_DATE,a.CONVERSION_RATE,a.CONVERSION_TYPE,a.CREATED_BY,a.CREATION_DATE,a.ENTERPRISE_ID,a.FROM_CURRENCY,a.LAST_UPDATED_BY,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN,a.OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER,a.RATE_SOURCE_CODE,a.STATUS_CODE,a.TO_CURRENCY,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time
from [rpy].[Exchange_Rates_Data_stage] a,
(select FROM_CURRENCY, TO_CURRENCY, CONVERSION_DATE, CONVERSION_TYPE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE, max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Exchange_Rates_Data_stage]
group by FROM_CURRENCY, TO_CURRENCY, CONVERSION_DATE, CONVERSION_TYPE, LAST_UPDATE_DATE) b
where a.FROM_CURRENCY = b.FROM_CURRENCY
and a.TO_CURRENCY = b.TO_CURRENCY
and a.CONVERSION_DATE = b.CONVERSION_DATE
and a.CONVERSION_TYPE = b.CONVERSION_TYPE
and a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE

insert into [rpy].[Expenditure_Types]
(ATTRIBUTE1,ATTRIBUTE10,ATTRIBUTE11,ATTRIBUTE12,ATTRIBUTE13,ATTRIBUTE14,ATTRIBUTE15,ATTRIBUTE2,
ATTRIBUTE3,ATTRIBUTE4,ATTRIBUTE5,ATTRIBUTE6,ATTRIBUTE7,ATTRIBUTE8,ATTRIBUTE9,ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY,
COST_RATE_FLAG,DESCRIPTION,END_DATE_ACTIVE,EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID,EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID,
EXPENDITURE_TYPE_NAME,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,PROCEEDS_FLAG,REVENUE_CATEGORY_CODE,START_DATE_ACTIVE,
UNIT_OF_MEASURE,source_name,sub_source_name,created_date_time)
select
a.ATTRIBUTE1,a.ATTRIBUTE10,a.ATTRIBUTE11,a.ATTRIBUTE12,a.ATTRIBUTE13,a.ATTRIBUTE14,a.ATTRIBUTE15,a.ATTRIBUTE2,a.
ATTRIBUTE3,a.ATTRIBUTE4,a.ATTRIBUTE5,a.ATTRIBUTE6,a.ATTRIBUTE7,a.ATTRIBUTE8,a.ATTRIBUTE9,a.ATTRIBUTE_CATEGORY,a.
COST_RATE_FLAG,a.DESCRIPTION,a.END_DATE_ACTIVE,a.EXPENDITURE_CATEGORY_ID,a.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID,a.
EXPENDITURE_TYPE_NAME,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.PROCEEDS_FLAG,a.REVENUE_CATEGORY_CODE,a.START_DATE_ACTIVE,a.
UNIT_OF_MEASURE,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time
from [rpy].[Expenditure_Types_stage] a,
(select EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Expenditure_Types_stage]
group by EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE) b
where a.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID = b.EXPENDITURE_TYPE_ID
and a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE

declare @temp_table table (
[person_no_external] [nvarchar] (50),

	[punch] [time] ,
	[device_name] [nvarchar](200) ,
	[punch_type] [varchar](100) ,
	[run_timestamp] [datetime] 
)
insert into @temp_table
execute usp_analytics_punch_extract '2022-01-01 00:00:00.000','2050-01-01'

select max(run_timestamp) as starttime 
from @temp_table
